whatRetiringMeans: C-S2 leaves the WS-3 capability target for the rest of this phase. The Stage D closeout reports it as the disclosed demonstration control, retired by this act: not debt, not a failure, and no score is claimed for it. Nothing is deleted -- its built code and the model-authored provisional bar remain as unratified artifacts of the run.
whyNotRatify: Ratifying grader-runner's bar would lift rung 1 only. C-S2 has no ratified acceptance oracle, so the capability would still read BLOCKED at rung 3 ('no boundary oracle') until a second artifact was authored, reviewed and ratified and the build re-run. Plan v1.1's claim boundary also rules out ratifying a bar to recover a score; a bar ratified here would be authored after the result, for that purpose.
returnPath: Grading may return in a later phase as a new capability, with a spec-authored bar and a spec-authored acceptance oracle, each ratified on its own act, under a new freeze.
